case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.reason: Two accused: appellant and co-accused son Harpartap Singh.

accused_gender.reason: Appellant is male; his son Harpartap is referred to as a male.

accused_age.reason: No age of the appellant appears anywhere in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of the accused is not mentioned.

accused_occupation.reason: Only that the appellant was in his fields; occupation is not explicitly stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_age.reason: No age of the deceased or any victim is given in the judgment.

victim_caste.reason: Caste of the victim is not mentioned.

victim_religion.reason: Religion of the victim is not mentioned.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Appellant and informant (victim's father) are brothers, so relatives.

offence_category.correct_value: Murder charged (ss.302, 307); conviction moderated to culpable homicide not amounting to murder (s.304 Part I)
offence_category.quote: conviction of the appellant ought to be moderated to one under Section 304 Part 1 IPC and 307 IPC
offence_category.reason: Murder was the charge, but the final conviction is under s.304 Part I, not murder.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC ss.302, 307 (charged); ss.304 Part I and 307 (final conviction)
statutory_provisions.quote: conviction of the appellant is converted to one under Section 304 Part I and 307 IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits s.304 Part I, the provision under which the conviction was finally recorded.

weapon.reason: The 12 bore DBBL gun is the weapon used.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical and recovery evidence (gun, cartridges, site plan) are relied on.

confession.reason: No confession by the accused is mentioned in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The judgment does not identify any aggravating circumstances.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Twelve years elapsed since the 2004 occurrence; appellant overpowered by uncontrollable anger; no intent to eliminate
mitigating_circumstances.quote: the occurrence is of the year 2004 and meanwhile twelve years have elapsed
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Judgment expressly weighs time lapse, provocation and lack of intent as mitigating.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under ss.302 and 307 IPC and acquitted co-accused.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court affirmed the conviction and sentence under ss.302 and 307 IPC
high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court has affirmed the conviction and the sentence recorded by the Trial Court
high_court_outcome.reason: The judgment states the High Court affirmed conviction and sentence, not that it was inapplicable.

final_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under s.304 Part I and s.307 IPC; appeal partly allowed; sentence reduced to period undergone
final_outcome.quote: The conviction of the appellant is converted to one under Section 304 Part I and 307 IPC
final_outcome.reason: Conviction continued but was modified and the appeal partly allowed; 'convicted' omits this.

offence_finally_established.reason: Court held offences established under s.304 Part I and s.307 IPC.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Sentence reduced to period already undergone (time served)
imprisonment_type.quote: the sentence for the offences is reduced to the period already undergone
imprisonment_type.reason: Judgment ties the sentence to time already served, not a stated fixed term.

imprisonment_years.correct_value: Not stated; sentence reduced to period already undergone
imprisonment_years.quote: the sentence is reduced to the period already undergone
imprisonment_years.reason: No numerical term is given; 0.0 is an inference from time-served wording.

fine_rs.correct_value: Rs.5,000 (s.302) and Rs.2,000 (s.307) imposed by trial court; not addressed by Supreme Court
fine_rs.quote: fine of Rs.5,000/- with default sentence under Section 302 IPC and ... fine of Rs.2,000/-
fine_rs.reason: Fines were imposed at trial; null ignores them, though the SC did not expressly address them.

neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate and do not reveal the Supreme Court's modification of the sentence.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state a minimum or maximum sentence range for the offences.

attempt_completion.correct_value: Completed as to deceased Jatinder Singh; attempted as to injured persons (s.307)
attempt_completion.quote: Jatinder succumbed to the injuries sustained
attempt_completion.reason: Death was completed but injuries to others were charged as attempt under s.307.

physical_harm.correct_value: Death of Jatinder Singh; injuries to informant Gurdial Singh, Paramjit Kaur and Lakhwinder Singh
physical_harm.quote: which hit Paramjit and Jatinder on their abdomen and Lakhwinder on his mouth and head
physical_harm.reason: Understates harm; informant and several other persons were injured, not just one.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Two offences charged; both convictions retained, with s.302 moderated to s.304 Part I and s.307 kept
number_of_offences.quote: conviction of the appellant is converted to one under Section 304 Part I and 307 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Both offences were upheld in modified form; 'one upheld' misstates the outcome.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is discussed.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court found the appellant acted in an uncontrollable fit of anger, not planned.

motive.correct_value: Lingering land dispute between brothers; anger over abuse of informant's son
motive.quote: over a lingering land dispute between the informant and the appellant, who are brothers
motive.reason: Judgment identifies a land dispute and abuse of the informant's son as motive.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Accurately reflects eyewitness and medical evidence accepted by the court.

witness_credibility.reason: Accurately reflects the court's rejection of the family-relationship challenge.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Appellant and co-accused fled the scene after hue and cry
post_offence_conduct.quote: On hue and cry being raised, the appellant and the accused fled the scene.
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment states the appellant and co-accused fled the scene.

custody_duration.reason: No numerical custody period is stated; only reduction to time undergone.

bail_history.reason: Bail history is not mentioned in the judgment.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence: 06.07.2002 (para 3; para 10 says 2004); trial court judgment date not stated; High Court judgment: 01.10.2008; Supreme Court: 02.12.2016
trial_duration.quote: passed by the High Court of Punjab and Haryana ... dated 01.10.2008
trial_duration.reason: Trial judgment date is unsupported; 01.10.2008 is the High Court judgment date.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment; appellant's counsel was amicus curiae.

investigation_status.reason: FIR registered, investigation completed, charge-sheet laid, trial completed.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted in the judgment.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court affirmance, and partly allowed Supreme Court appeal match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Prosecution argued eyewitness testimony, supported by medical evidence, proved the charge beyond reasonable doubt and concurrent findings should stand
prosecution_argument.quote: the charge levelled against the appellant stands proved beyond reasonable doubt
prosecution_argument.reason: Core argument is right, but attributing the co-accused acquittal point to the prosecution is not supported.

defence_argument.reason: Accurately reflects the amicus's arguments on co-accused acquittal, relationship, and sentence.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Court held co-accused acquittal has no bearing on the appellant's inculpatory involvement.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: No precedent is cited in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Accurately reflects time elapsed, anger, and lack of intent as reasons.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Accurately lists time elapsed, root cause, and uncontrollable anger.

other_sentence_order.reason: Judgment orders liberty forthwith unless required in another case.
